notes: Uptrend: prior close > prior SMA200 AND prior SMA200 > SMA200 20 sessions earlier; downtrend reverses both strict comparisons; all other cases transition.
Every contiguous episode is retained, including one-session whipsaws. No retrospective extrema or minimum-length merging. Episodes end retrospectively but labels were knowable at each session open.
All fixed calendar half-years are retained, clipped to available evaluation bounds and marked partial; 2026 H1 is complete. Calendar slices may contain multiple regimes.
Carry attribution includes prior holdings, original rebalance clock, costs and settlement from continuous parent runs. It is not a cash-start backtest or an entry-regime cohort study.

Cash restarts run the three reference strategies in all three scenarios separately per slice, with full prior warmup, no forced ending liquidation. Restarting monthly momentum resets its first rebalance date; this is a sensitivity analysis, not a tradable switch selected in advance.
2026 H1 additionally runs every parent ablation/control plus all book variants and their stresses. All other slice ablations/stresses are attributed from unchanged continuous parent replays.
Carry benchmark uses previous-close to final-close (first evaluation slice uses original first open). Cash restart benchmark uses first open to final close. Never mix denominators.

Slice win flags are descriptive after-cost return comparisons, not significance claims. Positive net P&L and excess over index are separate flags. A negative return that loses less than index is not profit.

No pooled 2022-2026 headline acceptance, no treating overlapping calendar/regime slices as independent samples, no aggregate p-value or cherry-picked best slice. Parent inference remains archived, not an approval gate.
Price-vintage/corporate-action, queue/impact and production execution-parity limitations remain. Backtest profits are simulated, not realized live-money profits.
